hook: Your photo here shows over 1,200 green mounds.
title: The Philippines Hills That Turn Chocolate
description:
The Chocolate Hills on Bohol island in the Philippines are more than 1,200 grass-covered mounds. In the dry season the grass turns brown, and the hills look like chocolate drops. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #ChocolateHills #Philippines
